## Compensation — card (Co)

The auditable pay-history record: employee, effective date, the whole package (reusing CompensationField), the reason, and the approver. Append-only in spirit — a correction is a new record, so history never rewrites itself.

### Non-goals

No approval workflow of its own in v1 (the approvedBy link records the decision; routing it could reuse the shared approval-chain blocks later). Employee.salary is not auto-synced from records — single-writer wiring is future work, noted so nobody assumes it exists.
